tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows smooth monotone concavity, but the narrow sweep cannot reliably separate a saturating law from a power law or identify behavior beyond the sampled branch. An open-branch discriminating measurement is the most targeted next step.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a saturating Michaelis–Menten/Haldane model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations are monotone and concave over the sampled input range, so they do not establish whether saturation continues or an alternative branch changes the response.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Cobb–Douglas power law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: With s_grad nearly constant, its exponent is poorly distinguished from a saturating response over this narrow input sweep.
The inputs show smooth, non-oscillatory behavior; finer sampling is less useful than probing the open-branch ambiguity.
It is not relevant to resolving the response-law ambiguity.
